name: apophenia
listed_description: Library for statistical and scientific computing. (awesome-c#Numerical, listed with http://apophenia.info, GPL-2.0-only)
reason: Same project as the b-k/apophenia seed below. Only a directional claim, no numbers and no named baseline: README says 'Being in C, it is often an order of magnitude faster when searching for optima or running MCMC chains'. The listed site http://apophenia.info is unreachable from this environment (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND); a web search found no benchmark or timing study.

name: Apophenia
listed_description: A C library for statistical and scientific computing. (awesome-cpp#Math, GPL2)
reason: Directional claim only: README says 'Being in C, it is often an order of magnitude faster when searching for optima or running MCMC chains' without naming a baseline (R or Stata implied) or giving a number. No benchmark in the repo page (dirs cmd, docs, eg, install, model, tests, transform), the README, or search results. 210 stars, GPLv2 via install/COPYING, last commit 2025-01-22.

name: BioC++
listed_description: C++ Computational Libraries for Bioinformatics. (awesome-cpp#Biology, BSD)
reason: No numeric comparison and no performance claim at all on the project page: it describes an 'extremely limited' framework for computational biology (BSD) whose newest dated news entry is 06.2006. Opened http://biocpp.sourceforge.net/; no repository, paper or shootout found with timings.

name: Chaste
listed_description: An open source C++ library for the computational simulation of mathematical models developed for physiology and biology. (awesome-cpp#Biology, BSD)
reason: No numbers against a named external baseline in anything reachable: the GitHub README and wiki page carry no speed claim. Published Chaste performance work (Bernabeu et al. 2014 parallel scaling; the 2009 libadaptivity paper reporting 10.9x over unmodified Chaste on a fine fixed mesh and 2-3x for time adaptivity) is a before/after self-comparison seen only as search-result snippets; the PDFs on discovery.ucl.ac.uk are egress-blocked (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND), so nothing was opened to quote. Repo: BSD-3-Clause, 155 stars, last commit 2026-10-07. A paper-access check could find cross-simulator timings (for example against openCARP).
